ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels; the visible ventral surface is approximately 98% low-intensity with localized white pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly uniform black field across both lobes. A distinct high-contrast white patch is located at the inner medial boundary of the left lobe, adjacent to the median notch. Minor white punctate clusters are mapped to the distal tips and lateral margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep bounding-box penetration; inner lobe edges converge at an approximate 40-degree angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular topography featuring variable-amplitude peaks and valleys; the left lobe displays deeper, more jagged indentations compared to the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curvature originating from the peduncle base and sweeping upwards and outwards to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial cluster of circular high-contrast white pixels on the distal tip of the right lobe and smaller clusters along the mid-lateral margin of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of several faint, unaligned low-contrast diagonal lines (gray-on-black) on the central-medial region of the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle colonization visible as a cluster of white circular growths on the far right distal tip; irregular jaggedness of the trailing edge indicates significant historical tissue loss/wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique white sliver or 'tick' mark located specifically on the interior edge of the left lobe where it meets the median notch.
